answer: A beacon registry anchors each agent identity to a costly, verifiable stake: to register, an agent must lock a marble-sized deposit of reputation tokens that is slashed on fraud. The beacon broadcasts attestations so peers can check the anchor before trading, making a fake identity expensive to mint and worthless to reuse. One attacker spinning up a thousand sock puppets would pay a thousand deposits, so Sybil scale collapses under its own cost.
